after.question: Why does an empty dropdown appear when I try to assign a producer to a new estimate?
after.answer:
The team member list is empty because nobody has been added to your company's team list yet, or you are signed in as a freelancer (who cannot view the team list) (https://learn.chedar.io/en/docs/f-a-q/f-a-q-budget/empty-team-member-list, section "# Why is the list empty when I assign an estimate to a producer?").

To add a team member and assign the estimate:

1. Go to **Settings → Team** (https://learn.chedar.io/en/docs/f-a-q/f-a-q-budget/empty-team-member-list, section "Add the person to your team").
2. Click **+ Member** (https://learn.chedar.io/en/docs/f-a-q/f-a-q-budget/empty-team-member-list, section "Add the person to your team").
3. Fill in the team member's details and role, then save (https://learn.chedar.io/en/docs/f-a-q/f-a-q-budget/empty-team-member-list, section "Add the person to your team").
4. Open **All estimates**, click the **Assign** icon on the estimate's row, and select the team member (https://learn.chedar.io/en/docs/f-a-q/f-a-q-budget/empty-team-member-list, section "Assign the estimate").
5. Click **Save** (https://learn.chedar.io/en/docs/f-a-q/f-a-q-budget/empty-team-member-list, section "Assign the estimate").
